Docs/Replay/Guide

Replay

Checked API recipes

1 min readOdin × GodotPage source ↓

recipes.odin instantiates three documented flows with the existing Hello/Duel models. Session runs a direct network simulation; Party stores enrollment before opening a Room for coordinated authority recovery; admitted P2P binds authenticated peers to a runtime that exchanges inputs and retains simulation history. It is a compile-checked reference, not another game or a claim that compilation validates networking. The actual runnable counterparts are linked in getting started.

Shell
nix develop --command bash tests/replay_recipes/run.sh

Keep runtime-owning structs at stable memory addresses. Pump Party before using its grant and keep it alive while RTC/Direct borrows authorization. Consume all presentation changes before the next frame. Use Room for elected authority recovery; a direct Session save/resume does not elect or fence hosts. The examples return errors; the embedding chooses UI/retry behavior and supplies its own content IDs.

bridge.odin also checks detached actor display, typed scene baking, and Room signal-action submission/results. tests/replay_nodes checks actual node, input, effect, and body lifecycles.

The recipe gate checks native and WASM builds with Odin's unused/shadowing, style, semicolon and tab checks scoped to replay_recipes, with warnings treated as errors. Imported generated bindings have their own style; global -strict-style and -disallow-do would also apply to those imports.

The bake example returns a copied definition. Its temporary Store's Ref remains local and expires when the Store is destroyed.

components.odin demonstrates an owned actor composed from health, movement and the shared gun mechanism. It introduces no engine state or component registry.
